de1d46f78c99.why: the ADR's account of a decision whose promise SPEC.md (the contract) states and truefit.toml registers from there: requires (§3.1, §5.1), the managed section (§4), a tool's check and the tap refresh (§3.5), a service's mapping (§7.3); one home per promise

e1cf52a32370.sentence: A command that cannot run or exits non-zero is refused with its exit and its stderr; a statement that is not a variable is refused by its line number, never its text.

e412303d6edd.sentence: Every command is non-interactive, takes `--json` (one JSON document on stdout; human text otherwise), writes diagnostics to stderr, and exits 0 on success, 1 when it refused or something failed, 2 on a usage error.

ea43581d3451.sentence: `doctor` runs `command` only with `--probe` (§7.4). A mapped service is not looked for in mytokens: its `check` runs on this machine (with `--host` too, as values are read only here); exit 0 is present, anything else is missing (`kind` `service`). One without a `check` is answered `unchecked` and does not make doctor refuse.

ea8387bde25a.sentence: The record keeps only the roles a person named; what they require is derived at each install and listed in the manifest with the rest, never written into the record.

ec5d58a19860.sentence: A toolchain that publishes daily (sunfmin/flux-toolchain) cannot be kept current by a pin: the pin would be copied from the tap into the library every day, by a commit a day and a cross-repo write credential, for the same result.
ec5d58a19860.why: an ADR's context, history, options or rationale (what was, what was weighed, why, how to undo it), not a promise a run of rolesmith could break

ecd415125531.sentence: for each program: tool.toml present (a role without one is refused as `show` refuses it), `check` passes (run by `sh -c`, exit 0); for each service and credential: mytokens entry present, read by `mytokens list` alone, or, for a service the host maps (§7.3), its `check` passes (without one it is `unchecked`, not missing). Exit 1 if anything is missing, each with the command that fixes it (`rolesmith tool install <source>/<role> [--host <host>]`, `mytokens put <entry> [--fields ...]`); with `--host` the checks run on that host over ssh, the entries are still read here; with `--project` every role the record names and each role it requires, at its recorded rev, each tool once (§3.5)

ece9ee8e4914.sentence: `env` exports every variable the command prints, under its own name.

f0609bc1fdf3.sentence: `rolesmith doctor --probe <role> | --project <dir> [--timeout <seconds>]` reads each mapped service's command once as `env` does, but in a session of its own (no controlling terminal) with stdin a pipe nothing writes to, for at most the bound (`--timeout`, default 20 s), and never prints or keeps a value.

f0a6274a372d.sentence: What a role builds on is declared in that role's `role.toml`: `requires = ["coder"]`, role names of the same library (SPEC §3.1). Invariant: **"X is also a Y" is written once, in X's role.toml; records name only the roles a person chose.**
f0a6274a372d.why: the ADR's account of a decision whose promise SPEC.md (the contract) states and truefit.toml registers from there: requires (§3.1, §5.1), the managed section (§4), a tool's check and the tap refresh (§3.5), a service's mapping (§7.3); one home per promise

f0eea7880c5c.sentence: validate a library working copy or one role; the library is the nearest of `--library` (default: the current directory) and its parents holding `library.toml`, as git finds its repository, so run in a role or a skill it checks the whole library as from the root, and outside any library it refuses as a directory with no `library.toml`, naming the directory it started from (§2, §3, §7.2); prints every problem, not the first, each with its file, line where there is one, and rule; exits 1 if there is any, and with `--json` lists them as `error.problems`

f4728c3d92dc.sentence: (On the file's first line it would hide the front matter: agents read front matter only from a first line `---`.)
f4728c3d92dc.why: rationale for where the comment goes (what agents read), not a promise of rolesmith's behaviour

f86045e23988.sentence: A personal account has no account-wide secrets, so slimfit's [ADR 0013](https://github.com/sunfmin/slimfit/blob/main/docs/adr/0013-releases-are-signed-and-notarized-by-the-taps-workflow.md) put them in one repo, sunfmin/homebrew-tap, whose `release` workflow signs every tool (contract: the tap's `.github/workflows/README.md`).
f86045e23988.why: an ADR's context, history, options or rationale (what was, what was weighed, why, how to undo it), not a promise a run of rolesmith could break

fbef11346f73.sentence: `source update` fetches and fast-forwards the local `main` (on whichever branch the working copy is); a `main` that moved apart from the library's is refused, never forced.

fdc8a5ca654e.sentence: The section was chosen because it arrives with the clone, so a new machine needs no setup and every agent that reads an entry file gets it; committing generated skills would give them a second home beside the record.
fdc8a5ca654e.why: an ADR's context, history, options or rationale (what was, what was weighed, why, how to undo it), not a promise a run of rolesmith could break

feb183956f03.sentence: `rolesmith env <role>` prints `export NAME='value'` lines (values single-quoted for sh) for every variable of its programs' `[credential]` (§3.5), each read from mytokens at that moment (`mytokens get <entry> --field <field>`, or `mytokens get <entry>` for `""`), for `eval "$(rolesmith env <role>)"`; `--json` gives them as `variables`. A service of the role that no program's `[credential]` names is read as a mytokens **Profile** when `mytokens list` lists it with kind `profile`: a Profile's fields are already variable names (what `mytokens env <entry>` exports), so each field is exported under its own name, read with `mytokens get <entry> --field <NAME>`. A service that is neither, and that this host does not map (§7.3), has no mapping to variables: `env` refuses the role, listing each such service (`error.unmapped`), and reads nothing.
